description: Action preflight gate: Deterministic preflight for an agent action before it runs: prompt-injection scan of the action text, URL public-host check (DNS-resolved, private ranges refused) with an optional host allow-list, JSON payload parse and required-key check, and a spend-cap check (amount_usd against max_usd). Returns allow or block with every rule's result. Source: X420 rules. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: verdict allow|block, checks[]{check, pass, detail}, injection.

allowed_hosts.description: comma-separated hosts the URL must match (optional)

amount_usd.description: amount the action would spend (optional, with max_usd)

payload.description: JSON payload the action would send (optional)

required_keys.description: comma-separated keys the payload must carry (optional)

text.description: the action text or untrusted content to scan (optional)

name: x420_security_action-gate
